findings.summary: FBI ARMS Reach memo identifies Ted Waitt as broker of Epstein-Gates introduction
findings.detail: FBI WFO Squad CR05 memo (EFTA00129096, April 3 2025, OPERATION TRIP KNOT, OCDETF) states: WAITT was the broker of the introduction between deceased convicted sex offender JEFFREY EPSTEIN and billionaire BILL GATES. This is in context of vetting Tim Draper for ARMS Reach (proximity to POTUS). The memo also identifies Waitt as a member of the Foresight Institute alongside convicted Chinese spy Charles Lieber.

findings.summary: Waitt called to testify before House Oversight Committee on Epstein investigation, April 16 2026
findings.detail: House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer sent letter to Theodore Ted W. Waitt on March 3, 2026 requesting transcribed interview on April 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM. Waitt is one of seven people called (alongside Bill Gates, Leon Black, Kathryn Ruemmler, and others). Committee states Waitt has information to assist investigation into Epstein/Maxwell. He is not accused of wrongdoing.

findings.summary: Waitt romantically involved with Ghislaine Maxwell 2003-2010, lent her social legitimacy in Silicon Valley
findings.detail: Ted Waitt dated Ghislaine Maxwell from approximately 2003 to 2010/2011. Maxwell met Waitt at a Clinton event in Hong Kong. Maxwell helped Waitt obtain and renovate the 240-foot yacht Plan B. They attended Chelsea Clinton wedding 2010 together. Maxwell used Waitts name to gain access to Silicon Valley power players. Eric Schmidt (Google CEO) met Maxwell through Waitt at a Clinton-linked event. Relationship ended due to blackmail attempts by Miami lawyer Scott Rothstein over Epstein civil lawsuits.

findings.summary: Waitt served on Foresight Institute nanotech steering committee with Charles Lieber and Steve Jurvetson (DFJ)
findings.detail: Ted Waitt (as Chairman of Avalon Capital Group and Waitt Family Foundation) served on the steering committee for the Foresight Nanotech Institute Technology Roadmap for Productive Nanosystems (2005-2007). Waitt Family Foundation provided initial 250K grant. Committee also included: Dr. Charles M. Lieber (Harvard, later convicted as Chinese spy under Thousand Talents Program), Steve Jurvetson (Managing Director, Draper Fisher Jurvetson - Tim Drapers VC firm), Paul Alivisatos (UC Berkeley), William Haseltine, J. findings.summary: Waitt donated 10-25M to Clinton Foundation; 416K to Hillary Victory Fund 2016; major Democratic donor
findings.detail: Clinton Foundation disclosed Waitt as a donor in the 10-25M range (Dec 2008 disclosure). FEC records show 416,100 to Hillary Victory Fund on 2016-10-20 plus numerous 10K state party donations. All from La Jolla, CA. Employer listed variously as Waitt Foundation, Avalon Capital Group, Gateway. This level of Clinton Foundation giving ensured Maxwell maintained her foothold with the Clinton family through Waitt.

findings.summary: Waitt introduced Ghislaine Maxwell to Eric Schmidt at Clinton-linked event; Maxwell used Waitt as social access vector to Silicon Valley elite
findings.detail: According to Daily Beast reporting, Eric Schmidt (Google CEO) met Maxwell through Waitt at an event linked to the Clintons. Maxwell leveraged Waitts name to gain access to Silicon Valley power players including Jeff Bezos. Some VIPs claimed they were introduced to Maxwell by Waitt, whose name lent her cachet. Maxwell, Chelsea Clinton, and husband Marc Mezvinsky flew together on a private plane with Waitt for a yacht trip.

findings.summary: Conflicting accounts on Epstein-Gates introduction: FBI memo credits Waitt but public reporting credits Melanie Walker and Boris Nikolic
findings.detail: The FBI ARMS Reach memo (EFTA00129096) states Waitt was the broker of the Epstein-Gates introduction. However, extensive public reporting (NYT, Fortune, Rolling Stone) credits Melanie Walker (Gates Foundation director who knew Epstein since 1992, introduced to him by Donald Trump) and Boris Nikolic (Gates chief science adviser) as the intermediaries who facilitated the first Gates-Epstein meeting on Jan 31, 2011. These accounts may not be mutually exclusive -- Waitt may have played an upstream role introducing Epstein into the circles that eventually led to Walker and Nikolic facilitating the direct meeting. The FBI memo represents an intelligence assessment, not necessarily a claim about a single dinner introduction.

findings.summary: Waitt Family Foundation funded Foresight Nanotech Institute 250K for nanotechnology roadmap (2005)
findings.detail: The Waitt Family Foundation provided an initial 250,000 grant to the Foresight Nanotech Institute and Battelle for the Technology Roadmap for Productive Nanosystems project (2005-2007). This placed Waitt on the steering committee alongside Charles Lieber (Harvard, later convicted Chinese spy for Thousand Talents Program) and Steve Jurvetson (Managing Director, Draper Fisher Jurvetson). Other committee members included Paul Alivisatos (UC Berkeley), J. Fraser Stoddart (UCLA), William Haseltine, Mauro Ferrari, John Randall (Zyvex), Jim Roberto (Oak Ridge), Robert Hwang (Brookhaven), and Alex Kawczak (Battelle).

findings.summary: 30+ Maxwell-Waitt personal emails in EFTA corpus from 2004, documenting active romantic relationship
findings.detail: LMSBAND corpus contains 30+ emails between Ted Waitt and Ghislaine Maxwell (Gmax), primarily from March-October 2004. Emails show casual romantic exchanges. Document IDs include EFTA00579231, EFTA00579023, EFTA00579015, EFTA00579291, EFTA00579027, EFTA00579196, and many others in the EFTA005790xx-EFTA005795xx range. Co-occurrence analysis shows Waitt documents also mention: Darren Indyke (Epstein lawyer), Epstein, Kevin Maxwell (Ghislaine brother), Prince Andrew, Jack Kidd, Grace Fodor, Arthur Mornington.
